scene_prompt: At a small respectful school ceremony, a child sits perfectly upright on a chair, shoulders straight, feet together and hands neatly on knees, attentive sincere expression toward an elderly guest speaking nearby. Peers sit more casually in soft background. Emphasize solemn respectful posture, not fear.
